ranges.note: Contracts authority errors: schemas, registry, dialects, rules, fixtures.

policy.stability: Codes are append-only. A frozen code is never reused for a different meaning; a deprecated code stays reserved. New codes require a contracts change.

codes.name: SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED
codes.meaning: A document failed validation against its registered schema under the declared dialect and policy.

codes.name: UNKNOWN_SCHEMA_ID
codes.meaning: The referenced $id is not present in the schema registry.

codes.name: DUPLICATE_SCHEMA_ID
codes.meaning: Two schema registrations share the same $id; the registration is mechanically rejected.

codes.name: DUPLICATE_PROTOCOL_NAME
codes.meaning: Two protocol registrations share the same name and version; the registration is mechanically rejected.

codes.name: UNRESOLVED_REF
codes.meaning: A $ref target cannot be resolved within the registered schema set.

codes.name: UNSUPPORTED_DIALECT
codes.meaning: The declared JSON Schema dialect is not in the frozen supported dialect set.

codes.name: UNKNOWN_CHECK_TYPE
codes.meaning: A rule uses a check type outside the finite set of nine.

codes.name: RULE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
codes.meaning: The mandatory rule count exceeds the first-version budget or the absolute cap.

codes.name: UNKNOWN_ERROR_CODE
codes.meaning: A fixture expectation references an error code that is not in this frozen registry.

codes.name: FIXTURE_EXPECTATION_MISMATCH
codes.meaning: A fixture did not behave as declared: a valid-expecting fixture failed, or an invalid-expecting fixture did not fail with the declared stable code.

codes.name: UNKNOWN_PROTOCOL
codes.meaning: A request references a protocol name/version that is not registered.

codes.name: SCHEMA_COMPILE_FAILED
codes.meaning: A registered schema does not compile under its declared dialect (the schema document itself is invalid).

codes.name: UNKNOWN_OPERATION
codes.meaning: The requested operation name is not in the frozen operation vocabulary of the referenced protocol version.

codes.name: INVALID_PARAMS
codes.meaning: Operation params do not satisfy the frozen params contract of the requested operation.

codes.name: EXECUTION_FAILED
codes.meaning: The mechanism runtime failed while executing a well-formed operation; details carry the mechanism evidence. Demonstrable only by a mechanism runtime, not by static contracts checks.
